description: This Java source file defines the CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler class which implements Spring Security's AuthenticationFailureHandler interface. It handles actions to take when user authentication fails, such as redirecting or forwarding to a failure URL, or returning an HTTP 401 error. The class manages how the authentication failure is presented to the user, including session exception storage and URL handling.

classes.name: CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler
classes.description: A Spring Security authentication failure handler that manages response behavior upon failed login attempts, including redirecting or forwarding to a designated URL, or returning an error code.

methods.name: onAuthenticationFailure
methods.description: Handles actions to be taken when user authentication fails, such as redirecting, forwarding, or error response.

methods.name: saveException
methods.description: Stores the AuthenticationException in the request attribute or session to be accessible in views.

methods.name: setDefaultFailureUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL to redirect to upon authentication failure, validating the URL format.

methods.name: isUseForward
methods.description: Checks whether forwarding is enabled for failure handling.

methods.name: setUseForward
methods.description: Enables or disables forwarding to the failure URL instead of redirecting.

methods.name: setRedirectStrategy
methods.description: Overrides the default redirect strategy used to send failure responses.

methods.name: isAllowSessionCreation
methods.description: Checks if session creation is allowed when storing exceptions.

methods.name: setAllowSessionCreation
methods.description: Sets whether to allow creating sessions during failure handling.
